# ELDT Training (eldttraining.us)

> ELDT Training is an online provider of FMCSA-compliant Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT) theory courses for commercial driver's license (CDL) applicants in all 50 US states, DC, and Puerto Rico. Courses cover Class A, Class B, the Class B to A upgrade, and the Hazmat (H), Passenger (P), School Bus (S), Tanker (N), and Hazmat + Tanker (X) endorsements. Completions are reported to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry (TPR).

Key facts:
- Federal ELDT rule: 49 CFR Part 380, Subparts F and G. Compliance date: February 7, 2022.
- ELDT applies to first-time Class A or Class B CDL applicants, Class B to Class A upgrades, and first-time H, P, or S endorsements. It does not apply to the N or T endorsements.
- Theory may be completed online with a TPR-registered provider; trainees must score at least 80% on the theory assessment. There is no federal minimum number of hours.
- Class A, Class B, P, and S also require behind-the-wheel (BTW) training with a registered BTW provider. H is theory only.
- Providers must report completions to the TPR by midnight of the second business day after the trainee finishes. State licensing agencies verify ELDT before the CDL skills test (or before the H knowledge test).
- ELDT Training courses: English only, with audio playback; self-paced; 3-month completion window and 1-year access.
- Company: ELDTtraining.us is a subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC, and partners with HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC. Phone (866) 429-6742. Email info@eldttraining.us.

## Guides

### ELDT Basics
- [What Is ELDT? Entry-Level Driver Training Explained](https://eldttraining.us/guides/what-is-eldt): ELDT means Entry-Level Driver Training, the FMCSA rule new CDL drivers must complete before testing. Who needs it, theory vs behind-the-wheel, cost.
- [ELDT Training Requirements: Who Needs It and What's Required](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-requirements): The complete ELDT requirements under 49 CFR Part 380: who must train, theory and behind-the-wheel rules, the 80% score, providers and state checks.
- [Online ELDT Training: How It Works and How to Know It's Legit](https://eldttraining.us/guides/online-eldt-training): Yes, ELDT theory can be completed online. How online ELDT courses work, what they cost, how completion reaches the FMCSA, and how to spot a legitimate provider.
- [ELDT Theory vs Behind-the-Wheel Training](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-theory-vs-behind-the-wheel): How ELDT theory and behind-the-wheel (BTW) training differ: what each covers, which licenses need both, range vs public road, order, providers and hours.
- [How Much Does ELDT Training Cost?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-cost): ELDT training cost in 2026: online theory runs about $50 to $150; behind-the-wheel and CDL school cost more. Prices by license, fees and ways to save.
- [How Long Is ELDT Training, and How Long Are Results Valid?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-long-is-eldt-training): How long ELDT takes: online theory runs about 5 to 15 hours with no federal minimum. Plus how long ELDT results stay valid and how fast states see them.
- [ELDT Certificate: How Certification Works and How to Verify It](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-certificate): What an ELDT certificate is, why the electronic TPR record is what counts, what gets reported, and what to do if your state can't see your training.
- [FMCSA Training Provider Registry (TPR): What It Is and How to Use It](https://eldttraining.us/guides/training-provider-registry): How the FMCSA Training Provider Registry works, how to verify an ELDT provider before you pay, what 2025-2026 removals mean, and how states see records.
- [ELDT Exemptions: Who Doesn't Need Entry-Level Driver Training](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-exemptions): Who is exempt from ELDT: drivers licensed before Feb 7, 2022, pre-2022 CLP holders, military skills-test waivers, restriction removals and more.
- [ELDT Curriculum: What Class A, B, H, P, and S Training Covers](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-curriculum): The full ELDT curriculum from 49 CFR Part 380 Appendices A to E: Class A and B theory units, BTW range and road skills, and H, P and S topics.
- [Free ELDT Training: Real Ways to Get ELDT Paid For](https://eldttraining.us/guides/free-eldt-training): Is free ELDT training real? Legitimate ways to get ELDT paid for: employers, carriers, school districts, WIOA grants, veterans benefits and low-cost options.
- [How to Choose the Best Online ELDT Training Provider](https://eldttraining.us/guides/best-online-eldt-training): How to choose the best online ELDT training: TPR registration, price, course length, audio and mobile support, reporting speed, support and refunds.
- [Do You Need ELDT for a Class C CDL?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-class-c): A Class C CDL alone doesn't require ELDT, but a first-time Passenger, School Bus or Hazmat endorsement does. What Class C covers and what you need.
### Getting Your CDL
- [How to Get a CDL: Step-by-Step Guide for 2026](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-to-get-a-cdl): How to get a CDL step by step: choose a class, DOT physical, CLP knowledge tests, 14-day wait, ELDT theory and behind-the-wheel training, and the skills test.
- [CDL Requirements: Everything You Need to Qualify](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-requirements): Federal CDL requirements for 2026: age, license, DOT medical card, English proficiency, Clearinghouse, knowledge tests, ELDT and the skills test.
- [CDL Permit (CLP): How to Get Your Commercial Learner's Permit](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-permit-clp): How to get a CDL permit (CLP): requirements, knowledge tests, the 14-day rule, CLP restrictions and endorsements, validity, and how it fits with ELDT.
- [How Long Does It Take to Get a CDL?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-long-does-it-take-to-get-a-cdl): Most people get a CDL in 4 to 8 weeks. A step-by-step timeline: DOT physical, CLP, 14-day wait, ELDT, behind-the-wheel and the skills test.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Get a CDL?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-much-does-it-cost-to-get-a-cdl): The full cost of a CDL in 2026: training ($3,000 to $10,000 at schools, less with online ELDT), DOT physical, permit, test and license fees.
- [How Old Do You Have to Be to Get a CDL?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-old-to-get-a-cdl): You can get a CDL at 18 for intrastate driving in most states, but must be 21 to drive interstate or haul hazmat. Age rules, endorsements and ELDT.
- [DOT Physical and Medical Card for CDL Drivers](https://eldttraining.us/guides/dot-physical-medical-card): What happens at a CDL DOT physical: vision, hearing and blood pressure standards, sleep apnea and diabetes, how long the medical card lasts and cost.
- [Class A CDL: What It Is, What You Can Drive, and How to Get One](https://eldttraining.us/guides/class-a-cdl): What a Class A CDL is, which vehicles it covers (26,001+ lbs GCWR towing over 10,000 lbs), jobs, requirements, Class A ELDT, and step-by-step how to get one.
- [Class B CDL: What It Is, What You Can Drive, and How to Get One](https://eldttraining.us/guides/class-b-cdl): What a Class B CDL covers (single vehicles 26,001+ lbs GVWR), common Class B jobs, requirements, Class B ELDT, and how to get your Class B license step by step.
- [Class A vs Class B CDL: Which One Should You Get?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/class-a-vs-class-b-cdl): Class A vs Class B CDL: vehicles, weight limits, jobs, pay, training time, ELDT and cost, plus a simple way to decide which license is right for you.
- [How to Upgrade from a Class B to a Class A CDL](https://eldttraining.us/guides/class-b-to-class-a-upgrade): How to upgrade a Class B CDL to Class A: why ELDT is required, the Class A permit and tests, upgrade theory, behind-the-wheel training and cost.
- [How to Get a CDL Without Going to CDL School](https://eldttraining.us/guides/how-to-get-a-cdl-without-school): Can you get a CDL without CDL school? Yes: online ELDT theory plus behind-the-wheel from an employer or BTW-only provider. Options, costs and rules.
- [English Language Proficiency Rules for CDL Drivers](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-english-language-proficiency): What the federal English proficiency rule requires of CDL drivers, the 2025 out-of-service change, how it's checked at roadside and how to prepare.
- [CDL Restrictions Explained: What L, Z, E, O, M, N, K, and V Mean](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-restrictions): What CDL restriction codes mean: air brake L and Z, manual E, tractor-trailer O, passenger M and N, intrastate K, medical V, and how to remove them.
### CDL Endorsements
- [CDL Endorsements: The Complete List (H, N, P, S, T, X)](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-endorsements): All six CDL endorsements explained: Hazmat (H), Tanker (N), Passenger (P), School Bus (S), Doubles/Triples (T) and X, and which ones require ELDT.
- [Hazmat Endorsement: How to Get Your CDL H Endorsement](https://eldttraining.us/guides/hazmat-endorsement): How to get a hazmat endorsement step by step: hazmat ELDT, the H knowledge test, TSA background check and fingerprints, cost, timeline and renewal.
- [Tanker Endorsement (N): Requirements, Test, and How to Get It](https://eldttraining.us/guides/tanker-endorsement): How to get a CDL tanker endorsement: what counts as a tank vehicle (119/1,000 gallon rule), the N knowledge test, liquid surge, ELDT rules and N vs X.
- [What Is the X Endorsement on a CDL?](https://eldttraining.us/guides/x-endorsement): The X endorsement combines hazmat (H) and tanker (N). What it covers, requirements, hazmat ELDT, TSA background check, knowledge tests, cost, and X vs H plus N.
- [Passenger Endorsement (P): How to Get It](https://eldttraining.us/guides/passenger-endorsement): How to get a CDL passenger (P) endorsement: who needs it (16+ occupants), P endorsement ELDT theory and behind-the-wheel, knowledge and skills tests.
- [School Bus Endorsement (S): How to Get It](https://eldttraining.us/guides/school-bus-endorsement): How to get a CDL school bus (S) endorsement: CDL class, P and S endorsements, S endorsement ELDT theory and BTW, knowledge and skills tests.
- [Doubles and Triples Endorsement (T): Requirements and Test](https://eldttraining.us/guides/doubles-triples-endorsement): How to get the CDL doubles/triples (T) endorsement: Class A requirement, the knowledge test, coupling doubles, where triples are legal, and ELDT.
### Tests & Skills
- [CDL Permit Test: What's on It and How to Pass](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-permit-test): What's on the CDL permit test: General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination and endorsement tests, question counts, the 80% passing score and study tips.
- [The ELDT Test: Theory Assessment, Passing Score, and Practice Questions](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-test): The ELDT theory test explained: 80% passing score, retakes, how it differs from the DMV permit test, plus 12 free ELDT practice questions with answers.
- [The CDL Skills Test: Pre-Trip, Backing, and Road Test Explained](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-skills-test): What happens on the CDL skills test: vehicle inspection, backing maneuvers and the road test, how it's scored, common mistakes and the ELDT check.
- [CDL Pre-Trip Inspection Checklist for Class A and Class B](https://eldttraining.us/guides/pre-trip-inspection-checklist): A complete CDL pre-trip inspection checklist: engine, cab, in-cab air brake test, lights, brakes, tires, coupling and trailer, with the key numbers.
### Careers & Employers
- [Paid CDL Training: How Company-Sponsored Programs Work](https://eldttraining.us/guides/paid-cdl-training): How company-sponsored CDL training works under ELDT: what's free, work commitments, repayment clauses, questions to ask, and online theory options.
- [ELDT for Employers and Fleets: What You Need to Know](https://eldttraining.us/guides/eldt-for-employers): ELDT compliance for carriers, school districts and transit agencies: who needs ELDT, online theory, registering as a BTW provider, verifying records.
- [CDL Jobs: What You Can Do With Each License and Endorsement](https://eldttraining.us/guides/cdl-jobs): Which jobs you can get with a Class A, B or C CDL and with hazmat, tanker, passenger and school bus endorsements, plus the ELDT each path requires.
